answer_prose: Among 16,368 linked Boston–Chicago race pairs, Chicago finishes averaged 1.0 minutes faster after equally weighting the two race orders. Fitness, weather and selection still differ; this is not a personal equivalent-time forecast.
detail_prose: These are observed time differences across consecutive recorded races, not a personalized equivalent-time calculator.
